name: Terran Dominion
description: Humanity's oldest stellar empire. Commands the central systems with iron discipline.

name: Xenoth Collective
description: A bio-organic hive civilization from the galactic rim. Their worlds are alive.

name: Syndicate of Stars
description: A ruthless mercantile empire built on secrets, blackmail, and galactic trade.

name: The Vanguard
description: A militaristic theocracy devoted to the study and mastery of forbidden technology.

name: Scavenger Clans
description: Nomadic raiders patrolling the dead zones. Feared for their ambushes and salvage expertise.
